name: Uneven Color From a Previous Refinish in Lynnwood: Can It Be Corrected
title-tag: Uneven Color After Refinishing: A Lynnwood, WA Guide
meta-description: Picture framing, drum marks, lap lines, blotchy stain: what causes uneven color after a refinish in Lynnwood, what fixes it, and what a correction costs.
post-summary: February 12, 2027 · Uneven color from a previous refinish is almost always correctable, but only from the wood up — no recoat or restorer reaches it. How to tell picture framing from drum marks from blotch that belongs to the species, why Lynnwood split-levels see it so often, and what correction costs.
